name: Tin Mountain Conservation Center Summer Camp
description_short: Nature-based summer camp programs for ages 4-16 in Albany, Jackson, Tamworth (NH) and Fryeburg (ME). Day campers explore fields and forests. Older "Explorer" programs include canoe trips (Canoe Voyageur) and climbing 4,000 ft peaks (Paths and Peaks).
refund_policy_summary: A $75 non-refundable deposit is due at registration. Full payment is due 4 weeks before camp starts. Cancellations or changes must be made at least 4 weeks before the session. No refunds after that.
